---
title: "Setup (Required)"
---

*Plan for about 30 minutes. Complete this on your own **before** your workshop, there is no setup time in the room.*

**Laptop requirement:** Bring your own Windows or macOS laptop (4GB+ RAM), plus a charging cord.

**If you get stuck at any point:** take a screenshot or copy the error text into Claude (or any AI chatbot) and ask for help troubleshooting. One or two loops usually unblocks you. Still stuck? Email [strategy-program@byu.edu](mailto:strategy-program@byu.edu), or come 15 minutes early and the triage table will sort you out.

## 1. Sign up for Claude Pro

*Skip if you already have a paid Claude account.*

Claude Pro is a **paid subscription (~$20/month)**. We're telling you plainly so nobody feels ambushed: the workshops require it, one month is enough, and you can downgrade or cancel afterward.

- [ ] Go to [claude.com/pricing](https://www.claude.com/pricing)
- [ ] Sign up for **Claude Pro** ($20/month, or $17/month paid annually)

## 2. Create a free GitHub account

- [ ] Go to [github.com](https://github.com/)
- [ ] Create a **free account**

## 3. Create a free Vercel account

*Needed for the Friday (TIM) build's deploy step, but do it now regardless; it takes one minute.*

- [ ] Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com/)
- [ ] Sign up for a **free account**, sign up **with your GitHub account** for easier deployment

## 4. Install Visual Studio Code (VS Code)

- [ ] Download from [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com/)
- [ ] During installation, if prompted:
  - [ ] Check **"Add to PATH"**
  - [ ] Enable **"Open with Code"** context-menu option (Windows users)

## 5. Install Claude Code inside VS Code

- [ ] Open **VS Code**
- [ ] In the top menu bar, click **Terminal → New Terminal**
  - This opens the **integrated terminal** at the bottom of VS Code, the terminal is where you'll run commands. You should see something like:

    ```
    PS C:\Users\YourName>   ← Windows
    or
    yourname@MacBook-Pro ~ %   ← macOS
    ```

Now install the **Claude Code CLI (command-line interface)**, the tool that connects VS Code directly to Claude.

::: {.callout-tip}
**Troubleshooting tip:** If something errors out, paste the error message and surrounding context into an AI chatbot and follow its instructions. Errors are usually missing dependencies; the chatbot will walk you through installing them.
:::

- [ ] Copy and paste **one** of these into the terminal (match your operating system), then press **Enter**:

**On Windows**

```bash
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

**On macOS**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

- [ ] When installation finishes, confirm it worked:

```bash
claude --version
```

You should see output similar to:

```bash
2.0.31 (Claude Code)
```

- [ ] Start Claude Code:

```bash
claude
```

You'll be prompted to authenticate with your Claude Pro account via a browser tab. Sign in, then return to VS Code, you should see the Claude Code welcome screen in the terminal.

Congratulations, you now have an agentic AI on your machine. Use it to finish the setup. Paste this prompt into the terminal where Claude Code is active:

> Please help me to install the following softwares or confirm they are already installed: 1) git, 2) node

Press **Enter** to approve when Claude asks to proceed. Claude Code works like a chatbot that can also run commands, it will complete the remaining installations with your approval.

> **Note on using the terminal**
>
> The terminal isn't a normal text editor, you **can't click into the middle of a line**. Use the **arrow keys** to move within the command you're typing, **Backspace/Delete** to erase, **↑** to recall your last command, and **↓** to move forward through history.

## 6. Verify your setup (2 minutes)

Do this before you travel. All three checks pass = you're ready for either room.

- [ ] In the VS Code terminal, run `claude --version`, you see a version number
- [ ] Run `git --version`, you see a version number
- [ ] Run `claude`, ask it anything ("say hello"), and confirm it responds, this proves you're logged in to your Claude account

If any check fails, work the troubleshooting loop above or email us. **Do not wait until you're in the room.**
